verdict.rationale: Shopify's UCP docs show merchant-scoped endpoints (catalog, cart, checkout) and agent profiles are automatically exposed per-shop (e.g. {shop}.myshopify.com/.well-known/ucp, /api/ucp/mcp) without a described merchant-facing toggle or agreement flow, suggesting some self-serve exposure, but the same documentation explicitly states order webhook subscription — a core piece of the agent-order lifecycle — is 'not self-serve: There's no self-serve subscription API today... To set up or update an order webhook subscription, contact your Shopify partner manager.' This directly undercuts a fully self-serve enablement story. missing for 10: an explicit merchant-facing 'enable agent commerce' setting or agreement flow, and a self-serve mechanism for webhook/endpoint registration instead of requiring partner-manager contact.
